paragraphs.text: Grothama , known as the All-Devouring , is a legendary Wurm from the plane of Kylem .

Grothama is a wurm featured in the stadium of Valor's Reach on Kylem. It has green-scaled skin and emerges from the ground to attack with its large gaping maw and multiple tongues. It appears to have some sort of red symbol on its bottom side.
